summary: Recorded the over-compaction probe that ran as experiment ebbec352695d43beb398bb1b239cda41-experiment (receipt 2cb2a3f1e43b4942b5bb3f42bad11091, all ten tests passed) plus the two follow-ups it forces. The probe reproduced the drift and leader change as intended (followers at accepted 9 over six indices of content after three rounds, events 122-123; the change left node 1 leading at accepted 9 / decided 9, node 2 at accepted 10, node 3 at accepted 7, events 126-128), but the intended compaction failed for a reason unrelated to the drift: snapshot(Some(9), true) on the new leader panicked inside NoSnapshot::create at omnipaxos/src/storage/mod.rs:205, the compacted index stayed 0 (event 129), and the two guarded re-synchronizations then completed with panicked false (events 133, 137) precisely because nothing was compacted, so the below-compacted route is still unexecuted. Because SequencePaxos::snapshot never consults T::Snapshot::use_snapshots() and reaches a stubbed constructor that panics, a documentation-legal public snapshot call on the default non-snapshot entry type aborts the caller instead of erroring. The update therefore adds the source range for the NoSnapshot stubs, a knowledge entry for that behavior, a new child question NoSnapshot snapshot call panics instead of being refused, rewrites the parent discriminator to record that its first attempt was blocked before compacting and that the snapshot-capable variant is the remaining route, and requests one successor experiment that adds a healthy-state NoSnapshot control plus the same probe over the snapshot-capable entry type so the below-compacted re-synchronization becomes observable. Incomplete: the new child question has no interpretation yet because an interpretation must name an investigation that already exists (the new id is assigned on acceptance), so that account is deferred to the next turn, and the trim child's gap b26c13954e184cd2b9fdfda975aff136-gap-4 stays open.
